questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes a 95% confidence interval for a population mean?

options.text: interval that will contain the true mean in 95% of samples
interval that will contain 95% of sample data
interval that will contain the true mean with 95% probability
interval that will contain 95% of population data

questions.explanation: A 95% confidence interval is constructed so that, in repeated sampling, 95% of such intervals will contain the true population mean.

questions.prompt: What does the standard error of the mean represent?

options.text: variability of sample mean across repeated samples

questions.explanation: The standard error quantifies how much the sample mean would vary if the sampling process were repeated many times.

questions.prompt: According to the Central Limit Theorem, as the sample size increases, the sampling distribution of the sample mean will become:
questions.explanation: The CLT states that the sampling distribution of the mean approaches a normal distribution as sample size grows, regardless of population shape.

questions.prompt: If you increase the confidence level from 90% to 99% while keeping the sample size constant, what happens to the width of the confidence interval?
questions.explanation: A higher confidence level requires a larger margin of error, so the interval becomes wider.

questions.prompt: Which of the following changes to a study will most likely reduce the margin of error for estimating a population proportion?
questions.explanation: Increasing the sample size reduces the standard error and thus narrows the margin of error.

questions.prompt: In a two‑tailed test for a population mean, what does the null hypothesis typically state?

options.text: The population mean is greater than the hypothesized value
The population mean is less than the hypothesized value
The population mean equals the hypothesized value

questions.explanation: The null hypothesis generally asserts that there is no difference, i.e., the mean equals the hypothesized value.
